title: Crystal Skies
description: Friendly Cobblemon 1.7.3 server for Fabric Minecraft 1.21.1!
body:
Crystal Skies Cobblemon is a friendly server running Cobblemon 1.7.3 for Fabric Minecraft 1.21.1

**IP:** cobblemon.crystalskies.org

To keep the server accessible, Cobblemon is the only mod you need to join! No big modpacks just lots of lil guys :)

We do also have a reccomened modpack you can use, if that makes playing easier for you.
[Link to Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/crystal-skies-cobblemon)

We have Keep Inventory on, and the server is in Peaceful mode. So you can spend less time running from skeletons, and more time playing Cobblemon!

✨We've got:

- All 1025 Pokémon!
- Ranks based on your dex completion %.
- Daily Rewards, including silly crates.
- Player run gyms, with types or themes.
- In-Game GTS and a Discord Market for trading.
- Legendary Raids + Different kinds of Bosses.
- Resource Overworld + End that reset monthly.
- Sell to the shop or other players, complete raids, hunts, and bosses to earn money!
- Shop for buying all the blocks, to make building easier :)
- Rotating shops on the docks with rare loot!
- Two tournaments a month, plus other events.
- Fun hats for players, and outfits for Cobblemon!

More information on our events, and guides on how to use our server side mods can be found in our Discord!
